title: Tech consultant Nima Momeni was sentenced to 16 years to life in prison for the second-degree murder of Cash App founder Bob Lee in 2023 (Heather Knight/New York Times)
summary: Heather Knight / New York Times: Tech consultant Nima Momeni was sentenced to 16 years to life in prison for the second-degree murder of Cash App founder Bob Lee in 2023 — Nima Momeni was sentenced for the 2023 murder of Bob Lee, a killing that initially set off crime fears in San Francisco.
